abi.layout: exact native-task-input.json; destination record page+0, payload+12; source+32
abi.safety: RUN must never return while hardware can still access task arena/mm; success requires all SAFE flags,4 submitted/4 completed,correct DIDs/addresses/resources

acceptance: host-checks.json and tests.log;13/13 unittest methods,10 real consumer files byte-identical;host and static RISC-V -Werror compilation
limits: No native DMA/Linux ioctl or FPGA execution.
Host-model trace describes logical serial protocol obligations only; it does not simulate/establish real COUNT,R/W/B,cache or context execution.
Test-only LD_PRELOAD mock exercises userspace validation, not kernel driver lifecycle.
Root must stage UAPI header and binary into build/rootfs if desired; this seat does not edit scripts/platform.py or rootfs.
Host lifecycle results validate C branch/cleanup behavior against controlled boundary contracts, not real Linux locking/GUP/IOMMU/cache/MMIO semantics.

lifecycle.scope: Actual driver C flow direct include; Linux/MMIO/IOMMU are host stubs. Retain-loop scheduler longjmp capture is not abort/recovery.
coverage: deadline then true DONE, no next publication
PTE A=0: ordinary IOVA/shadow pass, borrowed mode rejects before domain/publication and fully unpins
lifecycle.observed: Normal cleanup releases mapping/domain before pins/mm/mmap/task locks; unsafe keeps pins/mm/mmap/task lock/session and never returns.

cq_rtl.limits: Production CQ module RTL executed with test AXI memory/CSR boundaries; no cache consumers/CPU/Linux/RTL DMA/full-platform/FPGA or timing evidence
